unit.why: After a closing blessing and a quotation from the Komarner's preface on Torah study for wrong motives, R. Michel of Zlotshov predicts that a certain scholar will rule falsely, the prediction comes true, and he honours the Peri Megadim, telling him Heaven proclaimed that the halakha would follow him.
unit.boundary_note: opens with the close of the previous homily and a quoted teaching; the anecdote is embedded in that homiletic frame

stories.start_quote: ואמר הקדוש הרב מוהר״ר מיכל מזלאטשוב לתלמידיו
stories.end_quote: על שלומד בטהרה לשם אל עולם
stories.summary_en: R. Michel of Zlotshov tells his disciples that a scholar who studies Torah out of pride will never rule halakha correctly, which comes true, while he honours the Peri Megadim and tells him Heaven proclaimed that the halakha would follow him because he studies in purity.
